questions.input str: The things I want most are material (i.e. wealth, friends, property, items)
I aspire to be liked and may seek affirmation (i.e. of one's identity, worth, or capability)
I am most satisfied when I am able to directly support or aid others
The things I want most are immaterial (i.e. liberation, equity, knowledge)
I have particular views about myself that I attempt to self-affirm and adhere to
I am most satisfied when learning new skills or things (including self-care)
I feel drastically strong about my possessions and bonds
I am best able to describe myself in relation or comparison to others
Alienation and rejection is a significant internal fear of mine
I am often very certain of my choices (when I make them) or even if they "go wrong"
External affirmation doesn't land on me; I alone must prove things to myself
I am drawn to knowledge and self-change especially as it relates to my goals/ideals
My goals are hard-set and only change in response to external factors (i.e. security, company, expectations, optics, etc)
I am most likely to change or "adjust" my behaviour to maintain a relationship (platonic or not)
Humility comes to me naturally; I am a pillar of support
I am prone to frequent episodes of contemplation and/or reflection
I act in accordance with my own image
I am best described as scholarly, curious, or enigmatic
I don't tend to think about the things I can't see; I focus on what's in front of me
I find my sense of self is clearer within a social context (next to others)
I seek fulfillment through the betterment of my community/environment
I deeply concern myself with or care about history, the future, ideals, and social abstractions
In matters of the self, I am unwavered by external perspectives
I am fulfilled by bettering the self and mind
I can be described as "proud" or "prideful"
I feel I have a strong tendency to pursue "acceptance" above all
In any situation, I start by considering how best I may "help"/"support" others
I can be described as a "prudent" person or an "idealist"
I can be described as "stubbornly self-reliant" or "set in my ways"
I am viewed as or akin to, or aspire to be, a "polymath" or "savant"
